documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed eCollection eComments Requested; Extension Without Change, of a Previously Approved Collection; Procurement Collusion Strike Force Complaint Form
documents.summary: The Department of Justice Antitrust Division is requesting approval from the Office of Management and Budget to extend an information collection for the Procurement Collusion Strike Force Complaint Form, which allows the public to report potential antitrust crimes affecting government procurement. The document invites public comments for 30 days until November 5, 2026.
programs: Procurement Collusion Strike Force Complaint Form

documents.title: Public Hearing
documents.summary: This document announces a public hearing by the National Commission on the Future of the Navy scheduled for October 8, 2026, to discuss actions necessary to secure America's future maritime seapower with Navy, Marine Corps, and Joint uniformed leaders. The hearing is established in accordance with the National Defense Authorization Act of 2023 and is open to the public.
agencies: National Commission on the Future of the Navy
programs: National Commission on the Future of the Navy
statutes: Fiscal Year 2023 National Defense Authorization Act

documents.title: Precision Navigation Systems: Challenges Remain with Fielding New Capabilities
documents.summary: This GAO report examines the Department of Defense's efforts to modernize GPS and develop complementary positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) systems to address ongoing delays and security threats. The report finds that while some progress has been made on modernized GPS military code (M-code) receivers and complementary PNT systems, challenges remain with fielding and integration across fragmented military service efforts.

documents.title: PJM Interconnection, L.L.C.; Notice of Institution of Section 206 Proceeding and Refund Effective Date
documents.summary: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission issued a notice on September 29, 2026, instituting a Section 206 proceeding to investigate whether PJM Interconnection's proposed changes to establish the Reliability Backstop Procurement are unjust, unreasonable, or unlawful. The refund effective date for the proceeding is the date of publication of this notice in the Federal Register.

documents.title: Mortgage Lending: Newly Enacted Restrictions May Help Curb Unwanted Solicitations While Preserving Comparison Shopping
documents.summary: This GAO report examines mortgage trigger lead marketing, where credit reporting agencies sell homebuyers' information to lenders and brokers for solicitations. The document analyzes benefits and drawbacks of this practice and how the 2025 Homebuyers Privacy Protection Act's restrictions may affect homebuyers.

documents.title: Quantum Computing: Federal Actions Needed to Prepare for Emerging Cyber Threat
documents.summary: This Government Accountability Office (GAO) report examines the threat that quantum computers pose to federal agency cryptography and evaluates the extent to which 24 federal agencies have prepared to transition to post-quantum cryptography. The report finds that none of the 24 selected agencies fully addressed preparatory practices needed to mitigate the threat of cryptographically relevant quantum computers.
agencies: Office of the National Cyber Director

documents.title: General Services Administration Acquisition Regulation; GSAR Implementation of Executive Order 14275, Acquisition of Utility Services
documents.summary: GSA proposes to amend the General Services Administration Acquisition Regulation (GSAR) part 541 to implement Executive Order 14275 by relocating utility services acquisition procedures from FAR part 41 to GSAR to streamline the federal procurement process. The proposed rule aligns GSA guidance with FAR Council requirements and directs agencies to use GSA's areawide contracts and subject-matter expertise for utility acquisitions.

documents.title: Proposal of Special Measure Prohibiting the Transmittal of Funds Regarding Transactions Involving the A7 Network's Sub-Agents
documents.summary: FinCEN is proposing a rule that would prohibit financial institutions from processing certain fund transfers involving the A7 Network, a money laundering service with ties to Russia and Iran, which FinCEN has determined to be a primary money laundering concern related to Russian illicit finance. The proposed rule is issued under authority granted by the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act and the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022.
statutes: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022

documents.title: Public Health Preparedness: Action Needed to Address National and Biosecurity Risks Associated with Disposal of Federal Laboratory Equipment
documents.summary: This GAO audit report examines the sale of laboratory equipment by the Department of Health and Human Services and U.S. Department of Agriculture, finding that 9 pieces of equipment on the Commerce Control List were sold without proper reporting and that the agencies have not adequately assessed biosecurity risks associated with equipment disposal. The report recommends that HHS revise its policy and GSA create a standard approach for reporting controlled items to mitigate national security risks.
agencies: Department of Health and Human Services

documents.title: Internet of Things: OMB Action Needed to Ensure Agencies Secure Their Networked Devices
documents.summary: This GAO report examines federal agencies' implementation of Internet of Things (IoT) and networked device security requirements issued by the Office of Management and Budget. As of September 2026, most of the 22 civilian CFO Act agencies reviewed had not fully complied with OMB's requirements to establish and maintain inventories of networked devices, with only seven agencies having addressed all three requirements.

documents.title: Fraud in Federal Programs: Limited Beneficial Ownership Information Available on Awardees
documents.summary: This GAO report examines fraud in federal programs involving hidden beneficial ownership of companies receiving federal awards such as contracts, grants, and Medicare payments. The report finds that limited beneficial ownership information is available across federal and state data sources, leaving hundreds of billions of dollars in federal awards vulnerable to fraud, and notes that implementation of statutory requirements for a federal contractor beneficial ownership database has been delayed.
statutes: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2021

documents.title: Director of National Intelligence: Status of Open GAO Recommendations
documents.summary: This document is a GAO report on the status of recommendations made to the Director of National Intelligence from July 2011 through September 15, 2026. As of September 15, 2026, the Office of the DNI has implemented 76 of 139 recommendations (55 percent), with 57 recommendations remaining open that could improve intelligence management and oversight if fully implemented.
agencies: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
statutes: James M. Inhofe National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023

documents.title: Small Business Research Programs: Better Data Could Improve Insight into Companies’ Success
documents.summary: This GAO report examines the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) programs, which issued $4.4 billion in awards from 11 federal agencies in fiscal year 2024. The report finds that incomplete data on commercialization outcomes prevents agencies from effectively evaluating the success of open and conventional topic awards, as small businesses submitted required reports for less than half of their prior awards.
statutes: SBIR and STTR Extension Act of 2022

documents.title: Coast Guard: Additional Action Needed to Address Marine Firefighting Challenges
documents.summary: This Government Accountability Office (GAO) report examines nearshore marine fires and the challenges the U.S. Coast Guard faces in coordinating firefighting responses, finding that 886 fires occurred between 2015 and 2025 with about one quarter resulting in deaths, injuries, significant damage, or vessel loss. The report identifies gaps in the Coast Guard's efforts including the need for consistent field personnel coordination, hands-on firefighter training, information sharing mechanisms, guidance on vessel response plan activation, and expanded authority to require response plans for vessels using alternative fuels.
statutes: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026

documents.title: Cybersecurity Regulations: Industry Panelists Identify Duplication and Conflicts and Ways to Address Them
documents.summary: This GAO report documents findings from a July 16, 2026 panel discussion with industry representatives from energy, financial services, and healthcare sectors who identified duplication and conflicts among federal cybersecurity regulations. Industry participants recommended harmonizing regulations through consistent reporting timeframes and thresholds, and establishing a lead agency to coordinate incident reports.
agencies: Office of the National Cyber Director

documents.title: IT Systems Annual Assessment: DOD Should Improve IT Fraud Risk Management Practices
documents.summary: This Government Accountability Office (GAO) report assesses the Department of Defense's management of 18 major IT business programs, examining their progress on cost, schedule, and performance metrics from fiscal years 2024 through 2026. The report finds that while DOD is making efforts to improve IT investment management, several programs lack adequate fraud risk awareness training, software development tracking, and cybersecurity planning to meet departmental deadlines.
agencies: DOD Office of the Chief Information Officer
statutes: National Defense Authorization Act for FY 2019

documents.title: Revision of Firearms License Requirements
documents.summary: This final rule from the Bureau of Industry and Security rescinds an interim final rule from April 30, 2024 that imposed new export license requirements for firearms and ammunition, while maintaining new Export Control Classification Numbers and removing Congressional notification requirements for certain semi-automatic firearms license applications. The rule is effective September 30, 2025.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Various Port Fees in the Connectivity Fee Schedule
documents.summary: This document is a notice filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission by NYSE American LLC proposing to amend various port fees in its Connectivity Fee Schedule. The proposed rule change would increase monthly recurring fees for ports in the Mahwah Data Center by 9.1% to 11.1%, effective January 1, 2026.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Various Port Fees in the Connectivity Fee Schedule

The Exchange proposes to increase monthly recurring fees for ports in the Mahwah Data Center by 9.1% to 11.1%, with changes to become effective January 1, 2026.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE National, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Various Port Fees in the Connectivity Fee Schedule
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that NYSE National, Inc. filed a proposed rule change to amend port fees in its Connectivity Fee Schedule. The proposal would increase monthly recurring fees for various network access ports at the Mahwah Data Center by 9.1% to 11.1%, effective January 1, 2026.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Various Port Fees in the Connectivity Fee Schedule
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that NYSE Arca, Inc. filed a proposed rule change to amend port fees in its Connectivity Fee Schedule for the Mahwah Data Center. The Exchange proposes to increase monthly recurring fees for IP Network Access, IP and NMS Network Access, and LCN and NMS Network Access by amounts between 9.1% to 11.1%, effective January 1, 2026.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Various Port Fees in the Connectivity Fee Schedule
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding a proposed rule change filed by the New York Stock Exchange LLC to amend various port fees in the Connectivity Fee Schedule. The NYSE proposes to increase monthly recurring fees for ports in the Mahwah Data Center by amounts between 9.1% to 11.1%, with the changes to become operative on January 1, 2026.

documents.title: Normalizing Unmanned Aircraft Systems Beyond Visual Line of Sight Operations; Denial of Extension of Comment Period
documents.summary: This document denies requests to extend the comment period for a proposed rule on unmanned aircraft systems beyond visual line of sight operations published on August 7, 2025. The Federal Aviation Administration and Transportation Security Administration determined that the 60-day comment period provides sufficient opportunity and that meeting a presidential deadline requires closing comments as scheduled on October 6, 2025.

documents.title: Notice of Request for Information; Regulatory Reform on Artificial Intelligence
documents.summary: The Office of Science and Technology Policy requests public input to identify existing Federal statutes, regulations, agency rules, and administrative processes that unnecessarily hinder artificial intelligence development, deployment, and adoption in the United States. OSTP seeks input from all interested parties, including private sector organizations, academia, and government entities, to inform regulatory reform priorities to promote AI innovation.
agencies: Office of Science and Technology Policy

documents.title: Advisory Committee on the Medical Uses of Isotopes: Meeting Notice
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission announcing a meeting of the Advisory Committee on the Medical Uses of Isotopes scheduled for October 27-28, 2025. The meeting will include discussions on artificial intelligence applications, implementation of the ADVANCE Act, and updates on the Medical Radiation Safety Team's activities.
programs: Advisory Committee on the Medical Uses of Isotopes
statutes: Title 10 of the Code of Federal Regulations, Part 7

documents.title: Proposed Priority and Definitions-Secretary's Supplemental Priority and Definitions on Meaningful Learning Opportunities
documents.summary: This document proposes a new Secretary's Supplemental Priority on Meaningful Learning Opportunities for use in Department of Education discretionary grant programs. The priority is intended to complement existing supplemental priorities on topics including evidence-based literacy, educational choice, artificial intelligence, and patriotic education.

The priority is designed to expand access to career pathways and workforce readiness by integrating career exploration, technical education, and work-based learning into K-12 education.

agencies: Committee for Purchase from People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled

documents.title: Unmanned and Autonomous Flight Advisory Committee
documents.summary: The Department of Transportation Federal Aviation Administration solicits nominations for membership on the Unmanned and Autonomous Flight Advisory Committee (UAFAC), which provides advice to the Secretary of Transportation on policy and technical issues related to unmanned and autonomous aviation operations. Nominations must be received by October 24, 2025, and the committee comprises up to 12 representative members from specified stakeholder groups.

Section 44803 of title 49, United States Code

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Sapphire Fee Schedule To Establish Non-Transaction Fees Applicable to Floor Participants of the Exchange's Trading Floor
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding MIAX Sapphire, LLC's proposed rule change to amend its fee schedule. The proposed rule establishes non-transaction fees applicable to floor participants of the exchange's trading floor in Miami, Florida, effective September 12, 2025.

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Requests for Comments; Clearance of Renewed Approval of Information Collection: Small Unmanned Aircraft Registration System
documents.summary: This document is a Federal Aviation Administration notice inviting public comments on renewing an information collection for the Small Unmanned Aircraft Registration System. The collection involves registering small unmanned aircraft in a database to ensure accountability and allow identification of aircraft owners and operators.

documents.title: Improving Government Regulations; Unified Agenda of Federal Regulatory and Deregulatory Actions
documents.summary: This document is the Department of Defense's Semiannual Regulatory Agenda announcing regulatory and deregulatory actions DoD plans to take over the next 12 months and actions completed since the Fall 2024 Unified Agenda. It was developed under Executive Orders 12866 and 13563 to support Administration priorities and the Secretary of Defense's strategic objectives.

documents.title: Semiannual Regulatory Agenda
documents.summary: This is a semiannual regulatory agenda published by the Office of Federal Procurement Policy, Department of Defense, General Services Administration, and NASA that describes regulations being developed by the Civilian Agency Acquisition Council and Defense Acquisition Regulations Council in compliance with Executive Orders 12866, 13563, and 14192. The agenda provides summary descriptions of pending Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) rules in various stages of development to allow public participation in the rulemaking process.
statutes: Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act

documents.title: Notice of Final Nonavailability Waiver of Buy American Act Requirements: Port of Corpus Christi Authority To Purchase Marine Loading Arms
documents.summary: The Maritime Administration (MARAD) is issuing a final waiver of Buy American Act requirements allowing the Port of Corpus Christi Authority to purchase eight non-domestic 8-inch diameter marine loading arms for its Avery Point Public Oil Docks Redevelopment project funded under the FY 2019 Port Infrastructure Development Program. The waiver is based on a determination that domestic manufacturers cannot provide marine loading arms that comply with Buy American Act requirements.
programs: Avery Point Public Oil Docks Redevelopment--Phase 1: Expanding Oil Dock 3

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Requests for Comments; Clearance of a Renewed Approval of Information Collection: Remote Identification of Unmanned Aircraft Systems-Application for FAA-Recognized Identification Areas
documents.summary: This document is a Federal Aviation Administration notice requesting public comments on renewing an information collection related to applications for FAA-Recognized Identification Areas (FRIAs) for unmanned aircraft systems. The FAA seeks comments on the necessity, accuracy, and burden of the proposed information collection by October 22, 2025.

documents.title: Order Renewing Temporary Denial of Export Privileges; UTair Aviation JSC, Khanty-Mansiysk Airport, Tyumen Region, Russia 628012
documents.summary: This document renews a temporary denial order against UTair Aviation JSC, a Russian aviation company, prohibiting it from engaging in exports subject to U.S. regulations. The Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security found that renewal is necessary in the public interest to prevent imminent violations of the Export Administration Regulations, based on the company's pattern of repeated violations.
statutes: Section 766.24 of the Export Administration Regulations
John S. McCain National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2019

documents.title: Bureau of Industry and Security
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security, renewing a temporary denial order against Azur Air of Krasnoyarsk, Russia for violating export regulations. The order denies Azur Air's export privileges based on its pattern of repeated violations of the Export Administration Regulations.

documents.title: Order Renewing Temporary Denial of Export Privileges; PJSC Aeroflot, 1 Arbat St., 119019, Moscow, Russia
documents.summary: The Department of Commerce Bureau of Industry and Security renews a temporary denial order against PJSC Aeroflot, prohibiting the company from engaging in export activities, based on findings that renewal is necessary to prevent imminent violations of export regulations. The order was originally issued on April 7, 2022, and has been renewed multiple times, with this renewal requested on August 26, 2025.

documents.title: Accelerating Speed to Power/Winning the Artificial Intelligence Race: Federal Action To Rapidly Expand Grid Capacity and Enable Electricity Demand Growth
documents.summary: The Department of Energy is issuing a request for information to identify large-scale generation, transmission, and grid infrastructure projects that can accelerate electricity supply to meet growing demand from data centers, manufacturing, and AI applications. DOE seeks stakeholder input on projects and funding mechanisms to rapidly expand grid capacity across the country.

documents.title: Procurement List; Proposed Additions
documents.summary: The Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled is proposing to add janitorial and laundry services to the Procurement List, to be furnished by nonprofit agencies employing persons who are blind or have other severe disabilities. The Committee is seeking comments on these proposed additions by October 18, 2025.
agencies: Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled

documents.title: Notice of Rescission of Unmanned Aircraft Systems Operations Over People Declaration of Compliance, Tracking No. OOP000000178 for DJI Mavic 3 Multispectral (M3M) With AVSS Parachute Recovery System (PRS-M3E)
documents.summary: This notice from the Federal Aviation Administration rescinds a declaration of compliance for unmanned aircraft operations over people (tracking number OOP000000178) for the DJI Mavic 3 Multispectral with AVSS Parachute Recovery System, effective October 18, 2025. The rescission was requested voluntarily by Aerial Vehicle Safety Solutions because they no longer support this unmanned aircraft configuration and the parachute system is incompatible with the aircraft.

documents.title: Notice of Rescission of Unmanned Aircraft Systems Operations Over People Declaration of Compliance, Tracking No. OOP000000176 for Skydio X10 With AVSS Parachute Recovery System (PRS-X10)
documents.summary: This document is a Federal Aviation Administration notice rescinding a declaration of compliance for unmanned aircraft operations over people, specifically for the Skydio X10 with AVSS Parachute Recovery System. The FAA accepted the declaration on August 26, 2024, but rescinded it effective September 18, 2025, following a voluntary request from Aerial Vehicle Safety Solutions.

documents.title: Proposed Priority and Definitions-Secretary's Supplemental Priority and Definitions on Promoting Patriotic Education
documents.summary: The U.S. Department of Education proposes one additional priority and related definitions for use in discretionary grant programs to promote patriotic education, augmenting previously published Secretary's Supplemental Priorities on other topics. The proposed priority emphasizes cultivating citizenship competency and informed patriotism by understanding America's free-market economy, constitutional republic, and accurate history.
programs: Secretary's Supplemental Priorities on Evidence-Based Literacy, Educational Choice, and Returning Education to the States
Secretary's Supplemental Priority on Artificial Intelligence

documents.summary: This Federal Register notice announces decisions by the Department of Commerce on applications for duty-free entry of scientific instruments under the Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Materials Importation Act of 1966. The Department approved eight applications from research institutions to import foreign scientific instruments duty-free, finding no equivalent U.S.-manufactured instruments available for their intended research purposes.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Modify the IEX Fee Schedule Concerning Logical Order Entry Ports
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that Investors Exchange LLC has filed a proposed rule change to modify its fee schedule for logical order entry ports. The proposed change would increase fees for ports beyond those provided free of charge from $250 to $450 per month and reduce the number of free ports from five to three, effective October 1, 2025.

documents.title: Utah State University et. al; Application(s) for Duty-Free Entry of Scientific Instruments
documents.summary: This notice from the Department of Commerce International Trade Administration solicits public comments on seven applications from U.S. universities seeking duty-free entry for specialized scientific instruments under the Educational, Scientific and Cultural Materials Importation Act of 1966. The applications are for various analytical and measurement instruments manufactured outside the United States, with universities asserting that equivalent instruments are not manufactured domestically.
statutes: Educational, Scientific and Cultural Materials Importation Act of 1966

documents.title: Implementing Certain Tariff-Related Elements of the United States-Japan Agreement
documents.summary: This notice from the International Trade Administration announces amendments to the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States to implement tariff provisions from the United States-Japan Agreement announced on July 23, 2025. The notice implements Executive Order 14345, which directs changes to tariffs on Japanese goods including a baseline 15 percent ad valorem tariff on nearly all Japanese imports, with sector-specific treatment for automobiles, aerospace, pharmaceuticals, and natural resources.
agencies: International Trade Administration, U.S. Department of Commerce
programs: Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States

documents.title: Combined Notice of Filings #1

documents.title: Digital Health Advisory Committee; Notice of Meeting; Establishment of a Public Docket; Request for Comments-Generative Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Digital Mental Health Medical Devices

documents.title: Conformance of Cost Accounting Standards to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles for Operating Revenue and Lease Accounting

The rule follows an advanced notice of proposed rulemaking in November 2020 and a notice of proposed rulemaking in June 2024, and becomes effective October 14, 2025.

documents.title: Conformance of Cost Accounting Standards to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles for Cost Accounting Standards 404, 408, 409, and 411

The Board is combining two separate cases to streamline the rulemaking process for these four standards.

documents.title: Cooperative Research and Development Agreement: “VoiceBrain”

documents.title: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement: Assessing Contractor Implementation of Cybersecurity Requirements (DFARS Case 2019-D041)

documents.title: Restoring the United States Department of War
documents.summary: This is Executive Order 14347, issued September 5, 2025, authorizing the Secretary of Defense to use the additional secondary title of Secretary of War and permitting the Department of Defense to be referred to as the Department of War in official communications and contexts. The order requires the Secretary of War to notify Congress within 30 days of offices using the Department of War designation and to submit recommendations within 60 days on permanent renaming.

documents.title: International Traffic in Arms Regulations: U.S. Munitions List Targeted Revisions; Correction

documents.title: Implementing the United States-Japan Agreement

The order establishes a 15 percent baseline tariff on Japanese imports, sector-specific tariff treatment for certain goods, and provides details on Japanese commitments including $550 billion in U.S. investments and $8 billion annually in agricultural and other U.S. product purchases.

documents.title: Reinvigorating Merit-Based Hiring Through Candidate Ranking in the Competitive and Excepted Service (Rule of Many)

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule To Add Hardware Procurement Services and Managed Services

documents.summary: This Federal Register notice announces the New York Stock Exchange LLC's proposed rule change to amend its Connectivity Fee Schedule by adding hardware procurement services and managed services in the Mahwah Data Center colocation halls. The Securities and Exchange Commission is publishing the notice to solicit public comments on the proposed rule change.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE National, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule To Add Hardware Procurement Services and Managed Services
documents.summary: This document is a Federal Register notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that NYSE National, Inc. filed a proposed rule change on August 27, 2025. The proposed rule change would amend NYSE National's Connectivity Fee Schedule to add hardware procurement services and managed services in the colocation halls at the Mahwah Data Center.

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: National Initiative for Cybersecurity Careers and Studies Cybersecurity Education and Training Catalog Collection
documents.summary: This document is a 30-day notice from the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) requesting public comments on an Information Collection Request for the National Initiative for Cybersecurity Careers and Studies (NICCS) Cybersecurity Education and Training Catalog. programs: National Initiative for Cybersecurity Careers and Studies
statutes: Federal Information Security Management Act of 2002

documents.title: Revocation of Validated End-User Authorizations in the People's Republic of China
documents.summary: This final rule by the Bureau of Industry and Security amends the Export Administration Regulations to remove three semiconductor companies from the Validated End-User (VEU) Authorizations list for the People's Republic of China: Intel Semiconductor (Dalian) Ltd, Samsung China Semiconductor Co. Ltd, and SK hynix Semiconductor (China) Ltd. The rule becomes effective December 31, 2025, and is issued under authority of the Export Control Reform Act of 2018.

documents.title: Relaxing Export Controls for Syria
documents.summary: The Bureau of Industry and Security issues a final rule relaxing export controls on items to Syria under the Export Administration Regulations, consistent with Executive Order 14312 which directed removal of sanctions on Syria. The rule revises license application review policies, expands existing license exceptions, and adds new license exceptions for exports and reexports to Syria.
statutes: Chemical and Biological Weapons Control and Warfare Elimination Act of 1991

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Requests for Comments; Clearance of Renewed Approval of Information Collection: 2120-0776, Part 107 Authorizations and Waivers Under 14 CFR Part 107 and Airspace Authorizations in Controlled Airspace Under 49 U.S.C. 44809(a)(5)
documents.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration invites public comments on renewing Information Collection 2120-0776, which gathers information from Unmanned Aircraft Systems operators requesting authorization to operate in controlled airspace under 14 CFR Part 107 and 49 U.S.C. 44809(a)(5). programs: Low Altitude Authorization and Notification Capability

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission to the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) for Review and Approval; Comment Request; National Security and Critical Technology Assessments of the U.S. Industrial Base

programs: National Security and Critical Technology Assessments of the U.S. Industrial Base

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission to the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) for Review and Approval; Comment Request; BIS Program Evaluation
documents.summary: The Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security is submitting an information collection request to the Office of Management and Budget for review and approval of a voluntary survey used to gather feedback from export control seminars. documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission to the Office of Management and Budget for Review and Approval; Comment Request; SAFECOM Membership Questionnaire

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Infrastructure Visualization Platform (IVP) Pre-Collection Questionnaire
documents.summary: This Federal Register notice announces that the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is requesting a 30-day public comment period for a new information collection request regarding the Infrastructure Visualization Platform (IVP) Pre-Collection Questionnaire, which stakeholders must complete before CISA Protective Security Advisors conduct critical infrastructure security assessments. The questionnaire gathers information such as assessment purpose, points of contact, facility escort details, special considerations, and priority areas to help the assessment team plan their work.

documents.summary: This document is an order by the Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security denying export privileges to Jessica Alvarado for 10 years following her conviction for smuggling firearms and ammunition to Mexico without proper authorization. documents.title: International Traffic in Arms Regulations: U.S. Munitions List Targeted Revisions
documents.summary: The Department of State amends the International Traffic in Arms Regulations to revise the U.S. Munitions List by removing certain items, adding others, and clarifying descriptions, while also updating an interim final rule published on January 17, 2025. The Department adds a new license exemption for certain activities related to unmanned underwater vehicles.

documents.title: Renewal of Department of Defense Federal Advisory Committees-Defense Policy Board
documents.summary: The Department of Defense is publishing a notice to renew the Defense Policy Board (DPB), a federal advisory committee that provides independent advice to the Secretary of Defense on defense policy and national security matters. The DPB will consist of not more than 20 members with distinguished backgrounds in defense and national security, serving terms of one to four years with annual renewals.

documents.title: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement: Disclosure of DoD Funding in Technical Publications (DFARS Case 2024-D003)
documents.summary: This document proposes amendments to the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) to require contractors to disclose the amount of Department of Defense funding in public documents resulting from DoD-funded research and development activities. The proposed rule implements a requirement from the William M. Thornberry National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2021 and applies to public documents containing 280 or more characters.
agencies: Defense Acquisition Regulations System, Department of Defense
statutes: William M. Thornberry National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2021

documents.title: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement: Limitation on Certain Institutes of Higher Education (DFARS Case 2024-D023)
documents.summary: The Department of Defense issued a final rule amending the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) to implement sections of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024, which limit funds provided to institutions of higher education that host a Confucius Institute. The rule becomes effective August 25, 2025, and requires offerors to represent that they do not host a Confucius Institute or have obtained a waiver, with the waiver authority terminating on October 1, 2026.
agencies: Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering

documents.title: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement: Preventing Conflicts of Interest for Certain Consulting Services (DFARS Case 2024-D007)
documents.summary: The Department of Defense is issuing a final rule amending the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement to implement section 812 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024, which prohibits awarding contracts with certain NAICS codes to offerors holding contracts involving consulting services with covered foreign entities. The rule becomes effective October 24, 2025, and addresses public comments regarding clarifications to definitions and mitigation plan requirements.

documents.title: Information Collection Requirement; Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) Preventing Conflicts of Interest for Certain Consulting Services
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Defense Acquisition Regulations System announcing submission to OMB for clearance of an information collection requirement under the Paperwork Reduction Act regarding conflicts of interest in Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) consulting services contracts. The collection requires offerors to certify whether they or their affiliates hold contracts with covered foreign entities and to submit conflict-of-interest mitigation plans if applicable.
agencies: Defense Acquisition Regulations System, Department of Defense
statutes: Section 812 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024

documents.title: Request for Comment on 2025 Minimum Elements for a Software Bill of Materials
documents.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) announces a request for public comment on draft guidance titled '2025 Minimum Elements for a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM),' which updates and expands upon the 2021 NTIA SBOM Minimum Elements to reflect improvements in SBOM tooling and increased maturity of SBOM implementation. Comments are due by October 3, 2025, and CISA seeks input on whether elements should be removed, added, or clarified in the proposed voluntary guidance.
programs: 2025 Minimum Elements for a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Actively Exploited Vulnerability Submission Form
documents.summary: This Federal Register notice announces a 30-day public comment period for an Information Collection Request (ICR) submitted by CISA for a form allowing external reporting of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities. The form will enable members of the public, vendors, and researchers to propose vulnerabilities they believe meet CISA's KEV requirements for evaluation and potential inclusion in the KEV Catalog.

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Vulnerability Reporting Submission Form
documents.summary: This is a Federal Register notice from the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) announcing a 30-day public comment period for a new Information Collection Request regarding a Vulnerability Reporting Submission Form. CISA previously published this ICR for a 60-day comment period in October 2024 and received one comment; this notice extends the opportunity for additional public feedback.

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission to the Office of Management and Budget for Review and Approval; Comment Request; Speaker Request Form
documents.summary: This document is a Federal Register notice in which the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) submits an information collection request to the Office of Management and Budget for review and approval of the Speaker Request Form. CISA is providing an additional 30-day public comment period for this extension of a previously approved information collection.
statutes: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency Act of 2018

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Extension/Renewal of a Currently Approved Information Collection for Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Visitor Request Form
documents.summary: This document is a Federal Register notice from the Department of Homeland Security announcing an Information Collection Request for renewal of the CISA Visitor Request Form. The notice requests public comments by October 20, 2025, on the extension of an existing form (OMB Number 1670-0036) that CISA uses to screen visitors to its facilities.
agencies: Office of the Chief Security Officer (OCSO)

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Collection: Public Comment Request Information Collection Request Title: Membership Forms for Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network OMB No. 0915-0184-Revision
documents.summary: This is a Federal Register notice in which the Health Resources and Services Administration announces its plan to submit a revised Information Collection Request to the Office of Management and Budget for membership forms used by the Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network. HRSA is seeking public comments on the burden estimate and other aspects of the information collection by October 20, 2025.
agencies: Department of Health and Human Services

documents.title: Information Collection Request to Office of Management and Budget; OMB Control Number: 1625-0052

Comments must be submitted by October 20, 2025.
programs: Nondestructive Testing of Certain Cargo Tanks on Unmanned Barges

documents.title: Certain Foreign-Fabricated Semiconductor Devices, Products Containing the Same, and Components Thereof; Notice of Commission Determination Not To Review an Initial Determination To Amend the Complaint and Notice of Institution
documents.summary: The U.S. International Trade Commission determined not to review an initial decision allowing amendment of a complaint and notice of investigation in a semiconductor patent infringement case. The amendment substitutes Lenovo-related entities as respondents for Lenovo Group Ltd. and terminates Lenovo Group Ltd. from the investigation.

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission to the Office of Management and Budget for Review and Approval; Comment Request; Statewide Communication Interoperability Plan Template and Progress Report
documents.summary: This is a 30-day notice from the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) requesting public comments on an information collection request for the Statewide Communication Interoperability Plan (SCIP) Template and Progress Report. The collection is required to track state progress in implementing emergency communications interoperability goals as mandated by the Homeland Security Act of 2002.
programs: Statewide Communication Interoperability Plan (SCIP) Template and Progress Report

documents.title: Ensuring American Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Resilience by Filling the Strategic Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Reserve
documents.summary: This is Executive Order 14336, issued August 13, 2025, directing the Office of the Assistant Secretary for Preparedness and Response to develop a list of approximately 26 critical drugs and fill the Strategic Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Reserve with 6-month supplies of their active pharmaceutical ingredients, with preference for domestically manufactured APIs. The order also requires the development of a plan to obtain and maintain 6-month supplies of APIs for drugs on an updated essential medicines list and a proposal for opening a second SAPIR repository within one year.
agencies: Office of the Assistant Secretary for Preparedness and Response
Department of Health and Human Services

documents.title: Sunshine Act Meetings
documents.summary: This document is a Tennessee Valley Authority notice of a public Board of Directors meeting scheduled for August 21, 2025, at the Knoxville Office Complex. The notice lists the meeting time, location, agenda items to be considered, and instructions for public participation.

documents.title: Notice Pursuant to the National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993-Naval Surface Technology & Innovation

The notice discloses that 48 companies have withdrawn as members of NSTIC, with the filing made pursuant to the National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993 to maintain antitrust liability protections.
statutes: National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993

documents.title: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory et al. Application(s) for Duty-Free Entry of Scientific Instruments
documents.summary: This Federal Register notice invites public comments on seven applications from U.S. research institutions seeking duty-free entry for specialized scientific instruments under the Educational, Scientific and Cultural Materials Importation Act of 1966. Each application requests duty-free status based on the claim that no instruments of equivalent scientific value are manufactured in the United States.
statutes: Educational, Scientific and Cultural Materials Importation Act of 1966

documents.title: Request for Comments on the Renewal of a Previously Approved Collection: Quarterly Readiness of Strategic Seaport Facilities Reporting
documents.summary: The Maritime Administration requests Office of Management and Budget approval to renew an information collection (OMB 2133-0548) for quarterly reporting on the readiness of strategic seaport facilities used to evaluate commercial port capacity to support military deployment and national emergencies. programs: Quarterly Readiness of Strategic Seaport Facilities Reporting

documents.title: Continuation of U.S. Drug Interdiction Assistance to the Government of Colombia

The determination authorizes the Secretary of State to publish it in the Federal Register and notify Congress.
statutes: section 1012 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 1995

documents.title: South Dakota School of Mines and Technology et al.,Notice of Decision on Applicationfor Duty-Free Entry of Scientific Instruments

documents.title: Notice Pursuant to the National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993-Defense Industrial Based Consortium

programs: Department of Veteran Affairs Acquisition Regulation

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Requests for Comments; Clearance of a Renewed Approval of Information Collection: Pilot Certification Unmanned Aircraft Systems

The collection gathers applicant information to evaluate qualifications and eligibility for unmanned aircraft system remote pilot certification under Part 107.
programs: Integrated Airman Certification and Rating Application

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Requests for Comments; Clearance of a Renewed
documents.summary: The FAA is requesting OMB approval to renew an information collection requiring manufacturers of small unmanned aircraft to provide safety statements to owners at delivery. The document invites public comments on this renewal, which implements a statutory requirement from the FAA Extension, Safety, and Security Act of 2016.

documents.title: Normalizing Unmanned Aircraft Systems Beyond Visual Line of Sight Operations
documents.summary: This proposed rule from the FAA and TSA seeks to establish performance-based regulations allowing unmanned aircraft systems to operate beyond visual line of sight at low altitudes, including for package delivery, agriculture, and surveying, as directed by the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024. The TSA proposes complementary regulatory changes to ensure it can continue applying security measures to these operations.
programs: Low Altitude Authorization and Notification Capability

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Revision

The collection will gather procurement information necessary to administer and manage DOE's procurement and acquisition programs.

documents.title: Procurement List; Additions

agencies: Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled

documents.title: Supporting Fairness and Originality in NIH Research Applications
documents.summary: The National Institutes of Health (NIH) is issuing a notice establishing guidance on the appropriate use of artificial intelligence in research applications and instituting a new policy limiting principal investigators to submit no more than six applications per calendar year. This policy is effective for applications submitted on or after September 25, 2025, and aims to maintain fairness and originality in NIH's research application review process.

documents.title: Solicitation of Nominations for Appointment to the Advisory Committee to the Director

agencies: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

documents.title: Lower 37 GHz Band and Use of Spectrum Bands Above 24 GHz for Mobile Radio Service

The rule, effective July 14, 2025, was developed in collaboration with the National Telecommunications and Information Administration and the Department of Defense to enable services such as fixed wireless broadband and Internet of Things applications.

documents.title: Unleashing American Drone Dominance
documents.summary: This is Executive Order 14307, issued June 6, 2025, establishing U.S. policy to accelerate the safe commercialization and integration of unmanned aircraft systems (drones) into the National Airspace System while strengthening domestic production and exports. The order directs the Secretary of Transportation and FAA Administrator to issue rules enabling routine drone operations, deploy AI tools for waiver reviews, and publish an updated integration roadmap within specified timeframes.
agencies: Office of Science and Technology Policy

documents.title: Sustaining Select Efforts To Strengthen the Nation's Cybersecurity and Amending Executive Order 13694 and Executive Order 14144
documents.summary: This is Executive Order 14306, issued June 6, 2025, which amends Executive Order 13694 and Executive Order 14144 to sustain cybersecurity efforts and strengthen the nation's digital infrastructure against threats from foreign nations and criminals. The order directs federal agencies to take specific actions by set deadlines, including establishing industry consortiums, updating security guidance documents, and preparing for quantum computing threats to cryptography.

documents.title: Restoring American Airspace Sovereignty
documents.summary: This is an Executive Order (14305) issued on June 6, 2025, that establishes a federal task force and directs various agencies to develop policies and regulations to protect American airspace from threats posed by unmanned aircraft systems (drones). The order requires the FAA to issue new drone flight restrictions, directs enhanced law enforcement, and instructs agencies to make airspace information available in formats suitable for drone geofencing.

documents.title: Presidential Waiver of Statutory Requirements Pursuant to Section 303 of the Defense Production Act of 1950: Reviving the Manufacturing and Defense Industrial Base for Munitions and Minerals

documents.title: Reinvigorating the Nuclear Industrial Base
documents.summary: This is Executive Order 14302, issued May 23, 2025, which establishes a policy to expedite nuclear energy production and reinvigorate the domestic nuclear industrial base. The order directs the Secretary of Energy and other agencies to develop plans and reports within specified timeframes to strengthen the nuclear fuel cycle, expand uranium conversion and enrichment capacity, and secure civil nuclear supply chains.
agencies: Office of Science and Technology Policy

documents.title: Ordering the Reform of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission
documents.summary: This is Executive Order 14300, issued May 23, 2025, directing the Nuclear Regulatory Commission to reform its structure, personnel, regulations, and operations to accelerate nuclear energy deployment and licensing. The order states that the NRC has failed to license new reactors since 1978 and directs it to reduce regulatory barriers while maintaining safety, with policies aimed at expanding U.S. nuclear capacity from approximately 100 GW in 2024 to 400 GW by 2050.

documents.title: Deploying Advanced Nuclear Reactor Technologies for National Security
documents.summary: This is Executive Order 14299, issued May 23, 2025, directing the federal government to accelerate development and deployment of advanced nuclear reactor technologies at military installations and Department of Energy facilities to support national security objectives. The order establishes policies and assigns responsibilities to the Departments of Defense and Energy to rapidly implement nuclear energy systems for critical defense facilities and AI data centers.
programs: program of record for the utilization of nuclear energy
statutes: section 824o-1(c) of title 16, United States Code

documents.title: Reforming Nuclear Reactor Testing at the Department of Energy
documents.summary: This is Executive Order 14301 issued on May 23, 2025, which directs the Department of Energy to reform its nuclear reactor testing processes and expedite the review, approval, and deployment of advanced nuclear reactors at federal facilities. The order establishes definitions for qualified test reactors and requires the Secretary of Energy to issue guidance and revise departmental procedures to enable such reactors to become operational within 2 years of application submission.

documents.title: Presidential Determination Pursuant to Section 1245(d)(4)(B) and (C) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2012

The notice invites comments on the collection's practical utility, the agency's burden estimates, and ways to minimize respondent burden through automated collection techniques.
agencies: Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness

documents.title: Department of the Air Force Scientific Advisory Board; Notice of Federal Advisory Committee Meeting
documents.summary: The Department of Defense announces a closed meeting of the Department of the Air Force Scientific Advisory Board scheduled for January 30-31, 2025, to conduct midterm reviews of the board's fiscal year 2025 Secretary of the Air Force directed studies. The meeting will be held at Joint Base Andrews and is closed to the public due to discussion of classified matters.
agencies: Department of the Air Force Scientific Advisory Board
programs: Department of the Air Force Scientific Advisory Board

documents.title: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases; Notice of Closed Meeting
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases announcing a closed meeting of a Special Emphasis Panel scheduled for January 7, 2025. The meeting will review and evaluate contract proposals related to artificial intelligence applications in clinical microscopy for diagnosing infectious diseases.
agencies: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases
Department of Health and Human Services

documents.title: Standards for Business Practices of Interstate Natural Gas Pipelines
documents.summary: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission issues a final rule amending its regulations to incorporate by reference Version 4.0 of Standards for Business Practices of Interstate Natural Gas Pipelines adopted by the North American Energy Standards Board's Wholesale Gas Quadrant, with an effective date of February 7, 2025 and compliance required by August 1, 2025. The new standards are designed to promote greater efficiency and reliability of natural gas industry operations and strengthen cybersecurity protections.

documents.title: Biobased Markets Program
documents.summary: This is a final rule issued by the Rural Business-Cooperative Service adopting changes from the Agriculture Improvement Act of 2018 to streamline the Biobased Markets (BioPreferred) Program by merging two separate regulations into one. The rule combines the Guidelines for Designating Biobased Products for Federal Procurement and the Voluntary Labeling Program for Biobased Products into a single streamlined regulation effective January 8, 2025.
programs: Guidelines for Designating Biobased Products for Federal Procurement
Voluntary Labeling Program for Biobased Products
statutes: Farm Security and Rural Investment Act of 2002
Food, Conservation, and Energy Act of 2008

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: This document is a Securities and Exchange Commission notice of filing regarding The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC's proposed rule change to establish fees for its expanded co-location services. The notice describes Nasdaq's proposal to introduce new cabinet types, power options, and installation fees for its expanded data center facility in Carteret, New Jersey.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: This document is a Securities and Exchange Commission notice of a proposed rule change filed by Nasdaq ISE, LLC on November 18, 2024. The notice announces that ISE proposes to establish fees for its expanded co-location services, including monthly fees for Ultra High Density Cabinets and installation and power fees for its expanded NY11-4 data center in Carteret, NJ.
statutes: Section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq MRX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: This is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding Nasdaq MRX, LLC's proposed rule change to establish fees for expanded co-location services in its data center. The Exchange proposes to establish fees for Ultra High Density Cabinets, cabinet installation, power installation, and power distribution unit options in its expanded NY11-4 data center facility.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq BX, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding Nasdaq BX, Inc.'s proposed rule change to establish fees for expanded co-location services at its data center. The Exchange proposes to introduce new cabinet types and associated fees for its expanded NY11-4 data center facility in Carteret, New Jersey.
statutes: Section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: This document is a Federal Register notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding Nasdaq PHLX LLC's proposed rule change to establish fees for expanded co-location services in its data center. The Exchange proposes to establish monthly fees for Ultra High Density Cabinets, installation fees for cabinets, and fees for power installation and power distribution unit options in its expanded NY11-4 data center facility.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq GEMX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding Nasdaq GEMX, LLC's proposed rule change to establish fees for expanded co-location services at its data center facility. The Exchange proposes to introduce new cabinet types, installation fees, and power-related fees for services offered in its expanded NY11-4 data center.
statutes: Section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

documents.title: Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee; Request for Nominations
documents.summary: The Internal Revenue Service is requesting applications from qualified individuals to serve as members of the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee (ETAAC), with nominations due by January 31, 2025. The ETAAC provides advisory input on the IRS's electronic tax administration strategy and policies.
statutes: Internal Revenue Service Restructuring and Reform Act of 1998

documents.title: Notice of Lodging of Proposed Consent Decree Under the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act and Formerly Utilized Sites Remedial Action Program
documents.summary: The Department of Justice lodged a proposed Consent Decree on December 2, 2024, in a lawsuit against Cotter Corporation and Norfolk Southern Railway Company regarding contamination at the North St. Louis County Superfund Site in Missouri. Under the decree, the parties will pay a combined total of nearly $164,000,000 in response costs, and the document opens a 30-day public comment period.
agencies: United States Army Corps of Engineers
programs: Formerly Utilized Sites Remedial Action Program
statutes: Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act

documents.title: Procurement List; Proposed Additions and Deletions and Correction
documents.summary: The Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled proposes to add custodial services to the Procurement List, delete a binder product and mail/messenger services previously on the list, and correct a previous notice regarding Army combat uniform coats that will not be deleted. Comments are due by January 5, 2025.
agencies: Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled

documents.title: Request for Comments on the Reinstatement of a Previously Approved Information Collection: United States Marine Highway Program
documents.summary: The Maritime Administration invites public comments on reinstatement of an information collection (OMB 2133-0541) for the United States Marine Highway Program Grant Program, which was previously discontinued but is being restored to facilitate grant applications for marine highway transportation development. The document requests feedback on the necessity, accuracy, and burden of this information collection in accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995.
programs: United States Marine Highway Program Grant Program
statutes: James M. Inhofe National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023

documents.title: Foreign-Produced Direct Product Rule Additions, and Refinements to Controls for Advanced Computing and Semiconductor Manufacturing Items
documents.summary: This interim final rule by the Bureau of Industry and Security modifies Export Administration Regulations to add controls on advanced computing items, supercomputers, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and creates new Foreign Direct Product rules to impair production of advanced-node integrated circuits by entities of concern. The rule is effective December 2, 2024, with compliance dates ranging from immediate to December 31, 2024.

documents.title: Public Company Accounting Oversight Board; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rules on Firm Reporting
documents.summary: This document is a Federal Register notice published by the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board filed proposed rules with the SEC on November 22, 2024, amending annual and special reporting requirements for audit firms to mandate disclosure of more complete, standardized, and timely information including firm financial, governance, network, and cybersecurity information. The SEC is publishing this notice to solicit public comments on the proposed rules.

documents.title: Additions and Modifications to the Entity List; Removals From the Validated End-User (VEU) Program
documents.summary: This final rule by the Bureau of Industry and Security amends the Export Administration Regulations by adding 140 entities to the Entity List and modifying 14 existing entries, all involving advanced-node integrated circuits or semiconductor manufacturing and some supporting China's Military-Civil Fusion strategy. The rule also removes three entities from the Validated End-User Program and is effective December 2, 2024.

documents.title: Surplus Property; Notice of Additional Property at the Former Pueblo Chemical Depot
documents.summary: This notice amends a previous notice from December 20, 2013 to identify additional property at the former Pueblo Chemical Depot that has been determined surplus to United States needs. The property is being made available for conveyance to eligible entities for public benefit purposes under base closure laws and related authorities.
statutes: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024
Public Buildings, Property, and Works Act of 2002
Defense Base Closure and Realignment Act of 1990

documents.title: Marketing Submission Recommendations for a Predetermined Change Control Plan for Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Device Software Functions; Guidance for Industry and Food and Drug Administration Staff; Availability
documents.summary: The Food and Drug Administration announces the availability of final guidance on Marketing Submission Recommendations for a Predetermined Change Control Plan for Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Device Software Functions. The guidance provides recommendations on information to include in a PCCP for devices with AI-enabled software functions, allowing FDA review without requiring additional submissions for each modification.

documents.title: Public Briefing on Changes to Advanced Computing and Semiconductor Manufacturing Items
documents.summary: This document announces a virtual public briefing hosted by the Bureau of Industry and Security on December 5, 2024, to discuss two related rules concerning advanced computing and semiconductor manufacturing items and changes to the Entity List. The briefing will run from 3 p.m. to 4 p.m. EST, with registration required by 1 p.m. EST on the same day.

documents.title: Women-Owned Small Business Federal Contract Program Updates and Clarifications
documents.summary: This final rule updates the Small Business Administration's Women-Owned Small Business Federal Contract Program regulations by adding definitions, conforming regulations to current statutes, and implementing a statutory amendment from the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022. The rule also standardizes language across SBA's contracting programs regarding qualifying individual control and outside employment limitations, and changes the certification application review process.
programs: Women-Owned Small Business Federal Contract Program
statutes: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022

documents.title: Proposed Data Collection Submitted for Public Comment and Recommendations
documents.summary: This is a Federal Register notice from the CDC inviting public comment on a continuing data collection for the Research Data Center Proposal, which assesses researcher requests for access to confidential National Center for Health Statistics data. The collection is submitted pursuant to the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 and comments are due by February 3, 2025.
agencies: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
Department of Health and Human Services

documents.title: Privacy Act of 1974; Matching Program
documents.summary: This document is a notice of a modified 18-month computer matching agreement between the Department of Veterans Affairs and the Department of Defense to verify eligibility of Reserve force members receiving VA disability compensation or pension benefits who return to active duty. The agreement allows verification of continuing eligibility for VA benefits and ensures benefits are terminated or adjusted when veterans return to active duty.
statutes: Computer Matching and Privacy Protection Act of 1988
Emergency Veterans' Job Training Act of 1983
Service Members Occupational Conversion and Training Act of 1992

documents.title: Renewal of Department of Defense Federal Advisory Committees-Defense Health Board
documents.summary: This is a notice from the Department of Defense announcing the renewal of the Defense Health Board (DHB), a federal advisory committee that provides independent advice on health care policy and services for DoD beneficiaries. The DHB will have no more than 20 members and will focus on health care policy, service delivery, wellness, disease treatment, research priorities, and other health-related matters as directed by DoD leadership.

documents.title: DoD Discharge Appeal Review Board
documents.summary: This interim final rule implements Section 523 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2020, establishing the Discharge Appeal Review Board (DARB) as the DoD authority to provide service members with one final review of requests to upgrade their discharge characterization after all other administrative remedies have been exhausted. The rule details procedures for petitioners to request this final review, the standards DARB will apply, and the procedures Military Departments must follow after DARB adjudication.
agencies: Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness
statutes: Section 523 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2020

documents.title: Procurement List; Deletions

The deletions become effective on December 29, 2024, and apply to janitorial/custodial, grounds maintenance, and administrative services at various federal facilities.
agencies: Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled
General Services Administration Public Buildings Service

documents.title: Procurement List; Proposed Deletions
documents.summary: This document proposes the deletion of various military clothing and equipment items from the Procurement List that were previously supplied by nonprofit agencies employing persons who are blind or have other severe disabilities. Comments on the proposed deletions must be received by December 29, 2024.
agencies: Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled

documents.title: Imposition of Nonproliferation Measures Against Foreign Persons, Including a Ban on U.S. Government Procurement
documents.summary: The Department of State announces the imposition of nonproliferation measures against five foreign persons (three entities and two individuals) determined to have engaged in activities warranting sanctions under the Iran, North Korea, and Syria Nonproliferation Act. The measures, effective November 20, 2024, include bans on U.S. government procurement from these persons, prohibitions on assistance, termination of defense article sales, and suspension of export licenses for two years.
agencies: Office of Missile, Biological, and Chemical Nonproliferation
Bureau of International Security and Nonproliferation
statutes: Iran, North Korea, and Syria Nonproliferation Act

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Adjust FINRA Fees To Provide Sustainable Funding for FINRA's Regulatory Mission
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) has filed a proposed rule change to adjust its fees to provide sustainable funding for its regulatory mission. The proposed fee adjustments would be implemented over several years beginning in 2025, with the majority of fees taking effect in 2026 or later.

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activity Under OMB Review: Equipment Operation and Maintenance Manuals
documents.summary: This notice announces that the Department of Veterans Affairs' Procurement Policy and Warrant Management Service will submit an information collection regarding Equipment Operation and Maintenance Manuals (OMB Control No. 2900-0587) to the Office of Management and Budget for review and comment under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995. The collection involves contractors furnishing operation and maintenance manuals for technical medical equipment and other mechanical equipment, with an estimated annual burden of 745 hours across 22,337 respondents.
agencies: Procurement Policy and Warrant Management Service

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Renewal of an Existing ICR Collection and Request for Comment; Assessment of Environmental Performance Standards and Ecolabels for Federal Procurement
documents.summary: This document is a notice in which the Environmental Protection Agency announces a proposed renewal of an existing Information Collection Request (ICR No. 2516.05) regarding the assessment of environmental performance standards and ecolabels for federal procurement and solicits public comment on the collection through January 27, 2025. The ICR is currently approved through September 30, 2025, and covers EPA's evaluation of private sector standards and ecolabels to support federal sustainable acquisition goals.
programs: Assessment of Environmental Performance Standards and Ecolabels for Federal Procurement
Framework for the Assessment of Environmental Performance Standards and Ecolabels for Federal Purchasing

documents.title: Draft Revised Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) Organ Policy Equity Act Safeguards and Research Criteria for Transplantation of Organs Infected With HIV
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the National Institutes of Health requesting public comments on proposed revisions to research criteria for transplanting HIV-infected organs under the HOPE Act. The NIH proposes to delete research criteria specific to kidney and liver transplants and make additional changes based on scientific evidence review.
agencies: Department of Health and Human Services

documents.title: Notice of Availability of Proposed Circular Updates and Request for Comments
documents.summary: The Federal Transit Administration (FTA) is issuing a notice of availability for a proposed updated circular on Third Party Contracting Guidance that would replace Circular FTA C 4220.1F from 2013 and invites public comments on the proposed guidance. The updated circular reflects statutory and regulatory changes including the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act and the Fixing America's Surface Transportation Act, with a comment deadline of December 27, 2024.

documents.title: Organ Procurement and Transplantation: Implementation of the HIV Organ Policy Equity (HOPE) Act
documents.summary: This final rule from the Department of Health and Human Services amends regulations implementing the National Organ Transplant Act to remove clinical research and institutional review board requirements for transplantation of kidneys and livers from HIV-positive donors to HIV-positive recipients, as authorized by the HIV Organ Policy Equity (HOPE) Act. The rule directs the Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network to adopt quality standards for such HIV organ transplants consistent with existing law.
agencies: Department of Health and Human Services
Office of the Assistant Secretary for Health

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed eCollection eComments Requested; Records of Acquisition and Disposition, Registered Importers of Arms, Ammunition & Defense Articles on the U.S. Munitions Import List
documents.summary: The Department of Justice's Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives is submitting an information collection request to the Office of Management and Budget for review and approval regarding records of acquisition and disposition maintained by registered importers of arms, ammunition, and defense articles on the U.S. Munitions Import List. The notice solicits public comments for 30 days until December 27, 2024, on the proposed collection's necessity, burden, and quality.
agencies: Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives

documents.title: International Traffic in Arms Regulations: Extension of an Existing Temporary Modification of Category VIII of the U.S. Munitions List
documents.summary: The Department of State extends a temporary modification to the United States Munitions List Category VIII, allowing manufacturers to apply for export authorizations for defense articles used in the KF-21 aircraft development without removing those articles from the USML. The extension effective from November 26, 2024, maintains this temporary modification through December 1, 2026, or until the Department terminates it.
agencies: Office of Defense Trade Controls Policy

documents.title: National Artificial Intelligence Advisory Committee
documents.summary: The National Institute of Standards and Technology announces a virtual meeting of the National Artificial Intelligence Advisory Committee scheduled for December 12, 2024, from 2:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. Eastern time, where the committee will report working group findings, identify actionable recommendations, and receive public briefings.
agencies: National Institute of Standards and Technology

documents.title: Advanced Manufacturing Investment Credit Rules Under Sections 48D and 50; Correction

The corrections address typographical and formatting errors in the regulations published in the Federal Register on October 23, 2024.

documents.title: Senior Executive Service Performance Review Board Membership

documents.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Requests for Comments; Clearance of Renewed Approval of Information Collection: Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) BEYOND and Partnership for Safety Plan (PSP) Programs

documents.title: Revision of a Currently Approved Information Collection for Chemical-Terrorism Vulnerability Information (CVI)
