statutes: Protecting and Securing Chemical Facilities from Terrorist Attacks Act of 2014

documents.title: Presidential Determination Pursuant to Section 1245(d)(4)(B) and (C) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2012
documents.summary: This is a Presidential Determination issued by the President on November 7, 2024, pursuant to Section 1245(d)(4)(B) and (C) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2012. The President determines that there is sufficient supply of petroleum and petroleum products from countries other than Iran to permit a significant reduction in purchases from Iran by or through foreign financial institutions.
statutes: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2012, Section 1245(d)(4)(B) and (C)

documents.title: National Apprenticeship Week, 2024

programs: Scaling Apprenticeship Readiness Across the Building Trades Initiative

programs: Computer and Information Science and Engineering

documents.title: Export Administration Regulations: Revisions to Space-Related Export Controls; Extension of Comment Period
documents.summary: The Bureau of Industry and Security is extending the public comment deadline for its interim final rule on space-related export controls from November 22, 2024 to December 23, 2024. This extension allows commenters additional time to review the rule and benefit from BIS's ongoing public outreach before submitting their comments.

documents.title: Export Administration Regulations: Revisions to Space-Related Export Controls, Including Addition of License Exception Commercial Space Activities (CSA); Extension of Comment Period
documents.summary: The Bureau of Industry and Security is extending the public comment period for a proposed rule revising space-related export controls and adding a License Exception for Commercial Space Activities from November 22, 2024 to December 23, 2024. The extension allows commenters additional time to review the proposed rule and benefit from BIS's public outreach efforts.

documents.title: International Traffic in Arms Regulations: U.S. Munitions List Categories IV and XV; Extension of Comment Period
documents.summary: The Department of State is extending the public comment period for a proposed rule on International Traffic in Arms Regulations regarding U.S. Munitions List Categories IV and XV from November 22, 2024 to December 23, 2024. The original proposed rule was published on October 23, 2024 and proposes revisions to clarify regulatory text, add items to the munitions list, remove items that no longer warrant designation, and add three new license exemptions.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Service for Virtual Control Circuits in the Connectivity Fee Schedule
documents.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission publishes notice that the New York Stock Exchange LLC filed a proposed rule change on October 30, 2024, to amend the service for virtual control circuits in its Connectivity Fee Schedule. documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE National, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Service for Virtual Control Circuits in the Connectivity Fee Schedule

The proposed rule change deletes the phrase "between two Users" from the VCC service definition to accommodate VCCs that extend outside the Mahwah data center to remote access centers, with no change to the actual fees charged.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Chicago, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Service for Virtual Control Circuits in the Connectivity Fee Schedule

The proposed change would delete the phrase "between two Users" from the description of Virtual Control Circuits to reflect that VCCs can extend outside the Mahwah data center to remote access centers, though the fees would remain unchanged.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Service for Virtual Control Circuits in the Connectivity Fee Schedule
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that NYSE Arca, Inc. filed a proposed rule change on October 30, 2024, to amend the service for virtual control circuits in its Connectivity Fee Schedule. documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Amend the Service for Virtual Control Circuits in the Connectivity Fee Schedule

documents.title: Intent To Request Extension From OMB of One Current Public Collection of Information: Pipeline Operator Security Information

documents.title: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement: Disclosure of Information Regarding Foreign Obligations (DFARS Case 2018-D064)
documents.summary: The Department of Defense proposes to amend the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) to implement section 1655 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2019, which requires contractors to disclose information about sharing source code and computer code with foreign governments before DoD can acquire certain products, services, or systems. The proposed rule establishes new procedures, definitions, and contract clauses to enforce these disclosure requirements.

documents.title: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement: Inapplicability of Additional Defense-Unique Laws and Certain Non-Statutory DFARS Clauses to Commercial Item Contracts (DFARS Case 2018-D074)

The rule modifies DFARS sections 212.371 and 212.301 to specify which contract clauses apply or do not apply to commercial item acquisitions.
agencies: Defense Acquisition Regulations System, Department of Defense

documents.title: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation: Past Performance of Affiliate Companies of Small Business Concerns (DFARS Case 2024-D016)

documents.title: Government Owned Inventions Available for Licensing or Collaboration: Machine Learning Model for the Prioritization of Cancer Neoepitopes

agencies: Department of Health and Human Services

documents.title: Certain Semiconductor Devices, and Methods of Manufacturing Same and Products Containing the Same Notice of the Commission's Final Determination Finding a Violation of Section 337; Issuance of a Limited Exclusion Order and Cease and Desist Orders; Denial of Motion for Sanctions; Termination of the Investigation

documents.title: Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau Announces 15-Business Day Filing Window for Cybersecurity Labeling Administrator and Lead Administrator Applications
documents.summary: The Federal Communications Commission's Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau announces a 15-business day filing window for applications from entities seeking designation as Cybersecurity Labeling Administrator and Lead Administrator, and adopts additional requirements and responsibilities for these roles to implement the Commission's IoT labeling program. The rule becomes effective November 20, 2024, except for one amendment which is delayed indefinitely pending Office of Management and Budget review.
agencies: Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau

documents.title: Finding of No Significant Impact and Final Environmental Assessment for DARPA's Reefense Program, Baker Point, Florida
documents.summary: This document announces the availability of a Finding of No Significant Impact (FONSI) and Final Environmental Assessment for DARPA's Reefense Program at Baker Point, Florida, concluding that the proposed action will not significantly affect the human environment. The Reefense Program proposes installation of bio-hybrid oyster reef structures designed to attenuate wave energy and protect coastal infrastructure from flooding, erosion, and storm surge.

documents.title: Notice of Availability of the Final Environmental Impact Statement for Department of Energy Activities in Support of Commercial Production of High-Assay Low-Enriched Uranium (HALEU)
documents.summary: This document announces the availability of the Final Environmental Impact Statement (DOE/EIS-0559) for Department of Energy activities supporting commercial production of High-Assay Low-Enriched Uranium (HALEU). The DOE evaluated a proposed action to acquire HALEU from commercial sources over a 10-year period and facilitate commercial HALEU fuel production in accordance with the National Environmental Policy Act and the Energy Act of 2020.
agencies: Office of Nuclear Energy, Department of Energy

documents.title: Foreign-Trade Zone (FTZ) 143, Notification of Proposed Production Activity; Robert Bosch Semiconductor LLC; (Silicon Carbide Wafers); Roseville, California
documents.summary: This notice announces that Robert Bosch Semiconductor LLC has submitted a proposed production activity notification to the Foreign-Trade Zones Board for manufacturing metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs) using silicon carbide wafers at its facility in Roseville, California within FTZ 143. The Board is inviting public comment on the proposal through November 27, 2024.

documents.title: Hazardous Waste Management System; Identification and Listing of Hazardous Waste
documents.summary: The EPA is taking final action to remove an existing hazardous waste exclusion (delisting) that was previously granted to Samsung Austin Semiconductor because the facility has ceased the electroplating process that created the delisted waste. The removal is effective October 18, 2024, and involves amending 40 CFR Part 261 Appendix IX to remove Samsung's entry from the delisted waste table.
statutes: Hazardous and Solid Waste Amendments of 1984

documents.title: Privacy Act of 1974; Matching Program
documents.summary: This notice announces a re-established 18-month computer matching agreement between the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Benefits Administration and the Department of Defense Defense Manpower Data Center to identify veterans receiving VA compensation or pension benefits who are also in drilling status. The VA will use DoD records to adjust VA benefit payments as required by law.
programs: Emergency Veterans' Job Training Act of 1983
statutes: Computer Matching and Privacy Protection Act of 1988

documents.title: Delegation of Authority Under Section 506(a)(3) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961
documents.summary: This is a presidential memorandum delegating authority to the Secretary of State to direct a drawdown of up to $567 million in defense articles, services, and military education and training from the Department of Defense to provide assistance to Taiwan. The delegation is made under section 506(a)(3) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961.

documents.title: Delegation of Authority Under Section 506(a)(1) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961
documents.summary: This is a presidential memorandum dated September 26, 2024, delegating authority to the Secretary of State to direct a drawdown of up to $5.55 billion in defense articles, services, and military education and training from the Department of Defense to provide assistance to Ukraine. The delegation is made under section 506(a)(1) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961.

documents.title: Delegation of Authority Under Section 506(a)(1) and Section 614(a)(1) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961
documents.summary: This is a presidential memorandum delegating authority to the Secretary of State to direct defense assistance to Ukraine under specific provisions of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961. The memorandum authorizes the Secretary of State to draw down up to $375 million in defense articles and services and to determine whether to furnish up to $103 million in additional assistance to Ukraine.

documents.title: Voluntary Intermodal Sealift Agreement; Extension and Modification
documents.summary: The Maritime Administration announces the extension of the Voluntary Intermodal Sealift Agreement (VISA) until October 1, 2029, pursuant to Section 708 of the Defense Production Act of 1950. VISA makes intermodal shipping services and equipment available to the Department of Defense to support emergency deployment and sustainment of U.S. Armed Forces through cooperation among the maritime industry, Department of Transportation, and DoD.
statutes: Section 708 of the Defense Production Act of 1950

documents.title: Public Availability of the Department of Veterans Affairs Fiscal Year (FY) 2021 Service Contract Inventory Analysis Report
documents.summary: This is a notice from the Department of Veterans Affairs informing the public of the availability of the VA FY 2021 Service Contract Inventory Analysis Report and associated inventory, which provides information on service contracts over $150,000 and was developed in accordance with Office of Management and Budget guidance. The report discusses the methodology, analysis, and special interest functions studied from the FY 2021 inventory.
agencies: Office of Management and Budget's Office of Federal Procurement Policy
programs: VA FY 2021 Service Contract Inventory Analysis Report
Procurement Policy and Warrant Management Service
statutes: Section 743 of Division C of the Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2010

documents.title: Procurement List; Proposed Deletions
documents.summary: This document is a Federal Register notice in which the Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled proposes to delete certain products from the Procurement List that were previously furnished by nonprofit agencies employing persons who are blind or have other severe disabilities. The Committee invites public comments on these proposed deletions by November 17, 2024.
agencies: Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled
Defense Logistics Agency Land and Maritime
General Services Administration Federal Acquisition Service

documents.title: Procurement List; Additions and Deletions
documents.summary: This document adds one product (Advanced Instant Hand Sanitizer) to and deletes five products from the federal Procurement List, which identifies items that must be purchased from nonprofit agencies employing people who are blind or severely disabled. The additions and deletions were effective November 17, 2024, pursuant to the Javits-Wagner-O'Day Act.
agencies: Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled

documents.title: Request for Information: Executive Branch Agency Handling of Commercially Available Information Containing Personally Identifiable Information
documents.summary: This document is a Notice of Request for Information from the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) seeking public input on how federal agencies collect, process, and use commercially available information containing personally identifiable information. The request is issued as part of implementing Executive Order 14110 on artificial intelligence development and use, with comments due by December 16, 2024.

documents.title: Updated License Exception Implemented Export Controls (IEC) Eligible Items and Destinations
documents.summary: This final rule updates the License Exception Implemented Export Controls (IEC) table by revising its version date to September 17, 2024, and replacing the URL address with a simpler one at www.bis.gov/IEC. The updated table adds Denmark and Finland, and modifies Japan entries for appropriate item eligibility.

documents.title: Request for Comment on Product Security Bad Practices Guidance
documents.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) requests public feedback on draft Product Security Bad Practices guidance intended for software manufacturers developing products used in support of critical infrastructure. CISA seeks comments on the guidance's three categories covering product properties, security features, and organizational processes, with a comment deadline of December 2, 2024.

documents.title: Information Systems Technical Advisory Committee; Notice of Partially Closed Meeting
documents.summary: This document is a Federal Register notice announcing a partially closed meeting of the Information Systems Technical Advisory Committee scheduled for October 30-31, 2024, in Washington, DC. The Committee will review technical data and policy information related to export control reform, with portions of the meeting closed to protect trade secrets and premature disclosure of agency strategies.

documents.title: Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request
documents.summary: The Department of Agriculture submitted an information collection requirement to OMB for review under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 regarding the 2501 Program for outreach and assistance to socially disadvantaged farmers, veteran farmers, and beginning farmers and ranchers. The collection includes grant applications, performance reporting through a web-based system, and participant surveys, with an estimated 34,800 total burden hours across 5,120 respondents.
agencies: Office of Partnerships and Public Engagement
programs: Outreach and Assistance to Socially Disadvantaged Farmers and Ranchers and Veteran Farmers and Ranchers Program (2501 Program)

documents.title: International Day of the Girl, 2024
documents.summary: This is a presidential proclamation issued on October 10, 2024, recognizing International Day of the Girl and outlining the Administration's efforts to support girls through expanded child tax credits, mental health investments, violence prevention programs, and protections against gender-based violence and online harassment.
agencies: White House Task Force to Address Online Harassment and Abuse
programs: Advancing Women's and Girls' Civic and Political Leadership Initiative
statutes: Family Violence Prevention and Services Act

documents.title: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Program
documents.summary: This final rule establishes the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Program by the Department of Defense to verify that contractors have implemented required security measures to safeguard Federal Contract Information and Controlled Unclassified Information. The rule sets forth mechanisms for confirming that defense contractors and subcontractors have implemented security requirements for specified CMMC levels and maintain that status across the contract period of performance.
agencies: Office of the Department of Defense Chief Information Officer

documents.title: Notice of Issuance of Final Determination Concerning Surgical Towels
documents.summary: This document is a notice from U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) announcing a final determination on the country of origin of certain surgical towels. CBP has determined that surgical towels composed of Bangladeshi cotton fabric that is woven, dyed, and finished in Vietnam are products of Bangladesh for purposes of U.S. Government procurement.
statutes: Title III of the Trade Agreements Act of 1979

documents.title: Notice Pursuant to the National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993-Silicon Integration Initiative, Inc.
documents.summary: The Department of Justice Antitrust Division publishes a notice that Silicon Integration Initiative, Inc. (Si2) has filed notifications of membership changes to its cooperative research venture under the National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993. The notice describes five companies added as members, eleven companies that have withdrawn, two companies that changed names, and one acquisition by an existing member.
statutes: National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq MRX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: This document is a Securities and Exchange Commission notice published in the Federal Register announcing that Nasdaq MRX, LLC filed a proposed rule change to establish fees for expanded co-location services at its data center. The proposed rule change would establish monthly fees for Ultra High Density Cabinets, installation fees for cabinets, and fees for power installation and power distribution unit options in the expanded NY11-4 data center facility.
statutes: Section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding a proposed rule change filed by Nasdaq PHLX LLC to establish fees for expanded co-location services at its data center. The Exchange proposes to establish fees for ultra high density cabinets, installation fees for cabinets, power installation fees, and power distribution unit fees at its expanded NY11-4 data center facility.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: This document is a Securities and Exchange Commission notice announcing that The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC filed a proposed rule change to establish fees for expanded co-location services at its data center. The proposed rule change includes fees for Ultra High Density Cabinets, cabinet installation, power installation, and power distribution unit options at the expanded NY11-4 data center facility.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that Nasdaq ISE, LLC filed a proposed rule change to establish fees for its expanded co-location services in its data center. The Exchange proposes to establish monthly fees for Ultra High Density Cabinets and installation and power fees for expanded data center services in NY11-4.
statutes: Section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq BX, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission publishes a notice of a proposed rule change filed by Nasdaq BX, Inc. to establish fees for its expanded co-location services in its data center. The Exchange proposes to charge $7,230 monthly for Ultra High Density Cabinets and establish installation and power fees for its expanded NY11-4 data center facility.
statutes: Section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq GEMX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Fees for Its Expanded Co-Location Services
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that Nasdaq GEMX, LLC has filed a proposed rule change to establish fees for its expanded co-location services. The Exchange proposes to create fees for Ultra High Density Cabinets, cabinet installation, power installation, and power distribution units in its expanded data center facility NY11-4.
statutes: Section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

documents.title: Notice Pursuant to the National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993-Training & Readiness Accelerator II
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Department of Justice Antitrust Division pursuant to the National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993, informing the public that Training & Readiness Accelerator II (TReX II) has filed written notifications disclosing changes in its membership, including 49 newly added parties and one withdrawn party. The notice lists the companies and locations added to and removed from the venture as of September 4, 2024.
statutes: National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993

documents.title: Notice Pursuant to the National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993-Biopharmaceutical Manufacturing Preparedness Consortium
documents.summary: This is a notice from the Department of Justice's Antitrust Division published in the Federal Register regarding membership changes in the Biopharmaceutical Manufacturing Preparedness Consortium under the National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993. The notice discloses that 51 new parties have been added to the consortium and one party has withdrawn as of July 11, 2024.
statutes: National Cooperative Research and Production Act of 1993

documents.title: Procurement List; Deletions
documents.summary: This document deletes specific products and services from the Procurement List that were previously furnished by nonprofit agencies employing persons who are blind or have other severe disabilities. The deletions, effective November 10, 2024, include an entrenching tool carrier and various janitorial, mailroom, and grounds maintenance services previously provided by designated nonprofit suppliers.
agencies: Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled

documents.title: Procurement List; Proposed Deletions
documents.summary: This is a notice from the Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled proposing to delete four products from the Procurement List that were previously supplied by nonprofit agencies employing persons who are blind or have other severe disabilities. The Committee is accepting comments on these proposed deletions until November 10, 2024.
agencies: Committee for Purchase From People Who Are Blind or Severely Disabled

documents.title: Notice of Request for Public Comment on the Draft National Coral Reef Resilience Strategy
documents.summary: NOAA announces a request for public comments on the draft National Coral Reef Resilience Strategy in accordance with the Coral Reef Conservation Act of 2000 (as reauthorized). The National Strategy will replace the existing CRCP Strategic Plan and direct the work of the U.S. coral reef conservation community.
statutes: James M. Inhofe National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023

documents.title: Imposition of Special Measure Prohibiting the Transmittal of Funds Involving PM2BTC
documents.summary: FinCEN issues a final order prohibiting certain transmittals of funds involving PM2BTC, a cryptocurrency exchanger determined to be of primary money laundering concern in connection with Russian illicit finance. The order is issued pursuant to the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act and becomes effective October 11, 2024.
statutes: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE National, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that NYSE National, Inc. has filed a proposed rule change to delete the obsolete "Optic Low Latency Circuit-- 1 Gb" service from its Connectivity Fee Schedule. The notice explains that no market participants have used this service since it was added in 2023, and some participants indicated the 1 Gb size was too small for their needs.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Chicago, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
documents.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission publishes notice of NYSE Chicago, Inc.'s proposed rule change to delete the 'Optic Low Latency Circuit-- 1 Gb' service from its Connectivity Fee Schedule as obsolete due to lack of customer demand. The proposed change was filed on September 20, 2024, pursuant to Section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
statutes: Section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
documents.summary: This document is a Federal Register notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing NYSE Arca's proposed rule change to delete an obsolete service from its Connectivity Fee Schedule. The Exchange proposes to remove the "Optic Low Latency Circuit-- 1 Gb" service because no users have adopted it since its introduction in 2023.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that NYSE American LLC has filed a proposed rule change to amend its Connectivity Fee Schedule by deleting the obsolete 1 Gigabit Optic Low Latency Circuit service. The proposed change is effective immediately because no customers have used the 1 Gb service since it was added in 2023, with market participants indicating that the size is too small for their needs.

documents.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
documents.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission is publishing notice of the New York Stock Exchange LLC's proposed rule change to amend its Connectivity Fee Schedule by deleting the obsolete "Optic Low Latency Circuit-- 1 Gb" service, which has received no customer demand since its addition in 2023. The Exchange states the proposed change applies uniformly to all users and is consistent with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.

documents.title: International Security Advisory Board (ISAB) Meeting Notice
documents.summary: This is a notice from the Department of State announcing a closed meeting of the International Security Advisory Board (ISAB) scheduled for October 30, 2024. The meeting will be closed to the public to discuss classified matters related to arms control, disarmament, nonproliferation, biotechnology, and military strategy.

documents.title: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement: Procurement Technical Assistance Program (DFARS Case 2024-D006)
documents.summary: The Department of Defense issues a final rule amending the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) to implement section 853 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024, which modifies definitions of nonprofit organizations and business entities under the Procurement Technical Assistance Program. The rule clarifies that eligible entities include states, local governments, nonprofit organizations, and tribal organizations, while business entities that may receive assistance include corporations, associations, partnerships, limited liability companies, limited liability partnerships, consortia, not-for-profit, and other legal entities.

documents.title: Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement: Pilot Program To Incentivize Contracting With Employee-Owned Businesses (DFARS Case 2024-D004)
documents.summary: The Department of Defense is issuing a final rule amending the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) to implement provisions from the National Defense Authorization Acts for Fiscal Years 2022 and 2024 that establish a pilot program allowing noncompetitive awards of certain follow-on contracts to qualified employee-owned businesses. The rule becomes effective November 25, 2024, and addresses public comments received during the rulemaking process.
programs: Pilot Program To Incentivize Contracting With Employee-Owned Businesses
statutes: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022
National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024

documents.title: URAL Airlines JSC, Utrenniy Lane 1-g, Yekaterinburg, Russia 620025; Order Renewing Temporary Denial of Export Privileges
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the Department of Commerce renewing a temporary denial of export privileges against URAL Airlines JSC, a Russian company. The renewal is based on findings that the company has engaged in a pattern of repeated, ongoing violations of the Export Administration Regulations.

documents.title: Notice of the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council (FAR Council) In-Person and Virtual Listening Session
documents.summary: This document is a notice from the General Services Administration announcing an in-person and virtual listening session hosted by the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council (FAR Council) scheduled for December 4, 2024. The FAR Council invites industry partners and the public to share views on federal procurement policies, acquisition processes, and emerging technologies.
statutes: Office of Federal Procurement Policy (OFPP) Act

documents.title: National Manufacturing Day, 2024
documents.summary: This is Proclamation 10829, issued by President Joseph R. Biden Jr. on October 3, 2024, proclaiming October 4, 2024, as National Manufacturing Day to celebrate American manufacturing workers and recommit to supporting domestic manufacturing. The proclamation discusses the Administration's investments in American manufacturing through various legislative initiatives and policies to grow the economy and strengthen the middle class.
programs: Federal Research and Development in Support of Domestic Manufacturing and United States Jobs

documents.title: Local Redevelopment Authority for the Pueblo Chemical Depot
documents.summary: This notice designates the Pueblo Depot Activity Development Authority (dba PuebloPlex) as the Local Redevelopment Authority for the Pueblo Chemical Depot in Colorado, which will be closed and disposed of by the Army. The document provides contact information for the LRA and states it was recognized by the Secretary of Defense on July 25, 2024, pursuant to the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024 and the Defense Base Closure and Realignment Act of 1990.
agencies: Office of Local Defense Community Cooperation
statutes: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024
Defense Base Closure and Realignment Act of 1990
Pueblo Depot Activity Development Authority Act

documents.title: Addition of Certain Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances (PFAS) to the Toxics Release Inventory (TRI)
documents.summary: The EPA is proposing to add 16 individually listed per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and 15 PFAS categories to the Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) list under the Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act and Pollution Prevention Act to comply with the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2020. The proposal also addresses how PFAS categories should be treated and discusses what events may trigger automatic addition of PFAS to the TRI.
statutes: Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act (EPCRA)
National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2020 (NDAA)
